given.note: Linq's delivery receipt for the 4006 part comes within the minute, with its message id and the part's key echoed (K-11 partKey; verify-delivered-after-4006.json). No part holds that message id, so the call finds the part by its key: it holds no message id of its own, so the receipt is its. The part moves failed to delivered (K-07 'a 4001 or 4006 that delivered anyway') and keeps the message id, the row moves sending to delivered, and it is the row's first delivery, so no new key goes.
